caption: "trump tv" — 200,000+ searches this week for the White House press ban. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about who gets into the building.

Why: on Friday, September 18, Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico. Passes died Saturday. On Monday the three sued under the First and Fifth Amendments; Judge Timothy Kelly hears it on Wednesday. ABC, CBS, NBC and Fox suspended the video pool in solidarity.

What most people don't know: the same judge restored Jim Acosta's pass in 2018. The briefing room sits on Franklin Roosevelt's swimming pool and has 49 seats, assigned by the correspondents' association, not the White House.
Very simply put: passes pulled Saturday, lawsuit Monday, judge Wednesday.

slides.headline: Three newsrooms lost their White House passes. A judge decides *Wednesday*.
slides.sub: 10 things most people don't know about the press ban, 200,000+ searches this week.
slides.image: A tall white neoclassical building facade with columns under a bright blue sky, seen through a black iron fence, building in the upper two thirds of the frame, lower third plain green lawn, vivid, high contrast, photorealistic, no people, no flags, no text

slides.headline: Announced *Friday, September 18*. Passes dead by Saturday.
slides.sub: CNN, MS NOW and Politico. The White House called them 'FAKE NEWS', 'corrupt, purposeful, pervasive'.
slides.image: A blank white plastic press badge on a lanyard lying on a dark marble step, badge in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain dark marble, photorealistic, no readable text

slides.headline: They sued on Monday under the *First and Fifth* Amendments.
slides.sub: Viewpoint discrimination and no due process, the complaint says. It asks for the passes and the video pool back.
slides.image: A stack of legal documents with a fountain pen on a polished courthouse table, papers in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain dark wood, photorealistic, no readable text

slides.headline: The judge, Timothy Kelly, was *appointed by Trump*.
slides.sub: Trump wrote: 'we'll go for appeal', before any ruling. The hearing is Wednesday, by videoconference.
slides.image: An empty judge's bench with a gavel in a wood-panelled federal courtroom, bench in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain carpet, photorealistic, no people, no text

slides.headline: The same judge restored Jim Acosta's pass in *2018*.
slides.sub: CNN sued on November 13, 2018; Kelly ordered the pass back on November 16, on due process grounds.
slides.image: A television news camera on a tripod pointed at an empty podium in a bright room, camera in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain floor, photorealistic, no people, no logos, no text

slides.headline: ABC, CBS, NBC and Fox *stopped the video pool*.
slides.sub: The networks suspended pool coverage in solidarity. Monday's pool listed no TV outlet at all.
slides.image: A row of broadcast cameras with lens caps on, lined up against a wall, cameras in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain grey floor, photorealistic, no people, no logos, no text

slides.headline: The AP has fought a ban since *February 2025*.
slides.sub: Over 'Gulf of America'. A judge sided with the AP in April 2025; an appeals court stayed most of it. Still pending.
slides.image: An old globe on a wooden desk lit by a window, globe in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain desk, photorealistic, no readable text

slides.headline: The briefing room sits on *Roosevelt's swimming pool*.
slides.sub: Built by the March of Dimes for FDR, covered over in 1969 under Nixon. Named for James Brady in 2000.
slides.image: An empty vintage indoor swimming pool with tiled walls and still turquoise water, pool in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain tiled deck, photorealistic, no people, no text

slides.headline: *49 seats*, assigned by the correspondents, not the president.
slides.sub: The White House Correspondents' Association assigns them. Since February 2025 the White House decides who joins the pool.
slides.image: Rows of empty blue theatre-style seats facing a small podium in a narrow room, seats in the upper half of the frame, lower half plain carpet, photorealistic, no people, no text

slides.headline: Very simply put: passes pulled Saturday, lawsuit Monday, *judge Wednesday*.
